Definition: from G5613 and an adverb from G846; as thus, i.e. in the same way:--even so, likewise, after the same (in like) manner.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, hōsaútōs is the word for likewise, in the same way. In Matthew 20:5, the text says "and did likewise."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hōsaútōs I do not force more than it gives: likewise, in the same way.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
